description: Within one transcript, one cue has full speaker attribution and another has none (diarization dropped mid-call) — a real action and a real decision, one of each metadata shape.
ruleValidated: speaker and timestamp when the transcript has them; omit or empty string otherwise.

actions.quote: I'll update the deployment runbook by Monday.

notes: Unlike the golden-set fixtures (uniform metadata per transcript), this checks per-item metadata handling within a single transcript — one cue keeps its <v Name> tag, the next has none. Output must reflect that difference per item rather than applying one metadata rule to the whole transcript.
